additional_info.subject: RE: 0399581 - ID0399581-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R4 313059181001] The device without function CRM:00314000137
additional_info.body:
Dear Emre,
I hope all is well with you. Please be aware that I supported Furan and Mert yesterday during their site intervention. It is observed that there is a voltage drop in channel 2 of the emergency relay causing the fault. The voltage on IN2 dropped to 4V while connecting to the emergency relay. Upon checking the wiring, it was identified that there was a problem from the XD23 terminal. By removing the connection & refitting every related connection, the charger booted up normally. I am requesting you to monitor the charger for a couple of days, and if the error does not reappear, please proceed to close the ticket. In case of any error retentivity, please plan to replace the XD23 connectors.
Wiring check during the fault time:
Adding team in Loop.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
